aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable evidence but misgroups test rounds and includes invalid measurement outcomes.
issues: Changed-factor grouping mixes Test and Test (2) without preserving date/test round.
Test (2) contains no low-air-pressure condition, so it cannot directly compare to the changed condition.
Baseline combines normal lot with 2-2 film normal forming, which are distinct comparator contexts.
Measurement outcome is derived from defect-count headers, not true measurements.
Key source rows for low pressure content and decision are missing from draft citations.
requiredUserQuestions: Should Test and Test (2) be one validation case with separate test rounds or separate cases?
Should normal lot be treated only as comparator context distinct from 2-2 film normal forming?
correctionPlan: Use primary factor: 2-2 film roll forming pressure 5.6kg vs 3.5kg for Test sheet only.
Preserve date/sheet as test-round subgroup if combining sheets.
Keep normal lot as separate comparator context, not part of the pressure baseline.
Remove the measurement outcome and keep function NG rate defect outcome only.
Add citations for low-pressure content and decision rows, including Test!9 and Test!25.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Core cited rows exist, but current citations are incomplete and partly misapplied.
